requirements.title_zh: 构建世界级AI创新生态体系
report_sections: 统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究
AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 以六个国际案例提炼“距离—界面—入口”三条空间机制，落到 10 分钟步行圈、开放实验室界面与要素编组站三项可定位的空间动作，并由用地与公共空间图层承载。
requirements.evidence_summary_en: Six international cases yield three spatial mechanisms — distance, edge, entrance — landed as a 10-minute walking radius, an open-laboratory edge and the Marshalling Station, carried by the land-use and public-space layers.

requirements.title_zh: 建设适配AI新质生产力的新型城市形态
report_sections: 总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案
requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 适配 AI 新质生产力的城市形态被拆成可核验对象：10 个空间段落、48 个用地单元、日—夜—活动周三套时相供给，开发强度类结论一律标注待正式控规确认。
requirements.evidence_summary_en: The urban form for AI-era production is decomposed into checkable objects: ten belt segments, 48 land-use units and a day/night/event-week supply model, with every intensity conclusion marked pending official control conditions.

requirements.title_zh: 打造全球AI创新人才向往的高品质城区
report_sections: 蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 高品质城区由 6 类用户画像反推空间供给：9.72 km 无断点慢行、17.3% 绿地、6.8% 公共空间、人才居住与社区服务嵌入研发组团之间。
requirements.evidence_summary_en: Quality of place is derived from six personas: 9.72 km of uninterrupted walking, 17.3% green space, 6.8% public space, and talent housing and community services embedded between R&D clusters.

requirements.title_zh: 统筹研究范围
report_sections: 三层范围工作框架
统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究
requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 统筹研究范围 43.6 km² 只输出战略判断、生态图谱与案例转化机制，不输出红线；传导规则写入正文并由三层范围图表达。
requirements.evidence_summary_en: The 43.6 km² research area outputs only strategy, ecosystem mapping and case transfer — never redlines; the transmission rule is stated in the text and drawn in the scope diagram.

requirements.title_zh: 总体设计范围
report_sections: 三层范围工作框架
总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 总体设计范围 11.4 km² 由临时粗略边界复算为 1141.3 公顷，48 个用地单元完整覆盖、缝隙 0 m²；官方范围面积保持 unknown。
requirements.evidence_summary_en: The 11.4 km² overall design area recomputes to 1,141.3 ha from the provisional boundary, fully covered by 48 land-use units with a 0 m² gap; the official area stays unknown.

requirements.title_zh: 重点区域范围
report_sections: 三层范围工作框架
重点区域详细设计
requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 三处重点区域合计复算 369.3 公顷，与公告口径 368.4 公顷相差 +0.24%，差异来自临时几何本身并已在正文与假设中说明。
requirements.evidence_summary_en: The three key areas recompute to 369.3 ha, +0.24% against the announced 368.4 ha; the difference stems from the provisional geometry and is disclosed in the text and assumptions.

requirements.title_zh: 统筹研究范围：AI创新生态体系
report_sections: 统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究
requirements.evidence_summary_zh: AI 创新生态体系由编组翼（要素一址通办）、原点区（研究—开源—转化闭环）与试车翼（场景验证）三段构成，每段有空间载体与运营接口。
requirements.evidence_summary_en: The innovation ecosystem is built from three parts — the Marshalling Wing's one-address services, the Origin loop from research to translation, and the Test-Track Wing's validation — each with a spatial carrier and an operating interface.

requirements.title_zh: 统筹研究范围：适配人工智能的未来城市形态
report_sections: 统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究
蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 未来城市形态以时间结构组织：日常、夜间与活动周三套时相分别对应社区服务网络、原点协作空间与全线 K0–K9 临时化利用。
requirements.evidence_summary_en: Future urban form is organised by time: everyday, night and event-week modes map onto the community service network, Origin collaboration space and temporary use of K0–K9.

requirements.title_zh: 总体设计范围：产业目标与功能布局
report_sections: 总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案
requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 产业目标与功能布局由 10 个空间段落与 48 个用地单元表达，科研教育贴近高校、商业集中在门户与站点、居住嵌在研发组团之间。
requirements.evidence_summary_en: Industrial goals and programme are expressed through ten segments and 48 land-use units: research and education near campuses, commerce at gateways and stations, housing embedded between R&D clusters.

requirements.title_zh: 总体设计范围：城市更新总体框架
report_sections: 总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划
requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 城市更新总体框架给出低效空间识别方法（主脊 300 米内、背靠背、首层封闭）、18 个更新项目与三期互不重叠且合并覆盖全域的分期范围。
requirements.evidence_summary_en: The renewal framework provides an identification method (within 300 m of the spine, back-to-back, closed ground floor), 18 projects, and three non-overlapping phases that together cover the whole area.

requirements.title_zh: 总体设计范围：交通轨道市政配套设施
report_sections: 交通、轨道、市政与公共服务设施
requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 交通策略以断点治理三原则组织：主线 9.72 km、5 条缝合廊道、4 处站点地面接驳；不给出红线、线位与工程结论，市政按“设施跟着场景走”布点。
requirements.evidence_summary_en: Mobility follows three barrier rules: a 9.72 km main line, five stitching corridors and four ground-level station connections; no redline, alignment or engineering conclusion is given, and utilities follow scenarios.

requirements.title_zh: 总体设计范围：京张遗址公园活力带
report_sections: 蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划
requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 京张遗址公园活力带以折返脊命名并贯通：10 处里程碑广场、5 条缝合廊道、3 处市民客厅与 4 处朝圣地标，公园廊道典型宽度约 120 米。
requirements.evidence_summary_en: The heritage park vitality belt is named and connected as the Switchback Spine: ten milestone plazas, five stitching corridors, three civic rooms and four pilgrimage landmarks, with a typical 120 m corridor.

requirements.title_zh: 总体设计范围：城市风貌
report_sections: 蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 城市风貌给出控制方法而非数值：主脊两侧低到高的梯度界面、跨线与门户节点的高度校核视点，具体高度密度退线保持 unknown。
requirements.evidence_summary_en: Urban character offers method rather than numbers: a graded edge rising away from the spine and height verification viewpoints at crossings and gateways, with heights, densities and setbacks left unknown.

requirements.title_zh: 重点区域范围详细设计必选项
report_sections: 重点区域详细设计
requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 三处重点区域分别给出定位差异、四条空间动作、三张对应场景卡、三个项目抓手与风险条件，避免同质化表述。
requirements.evidence_summary_en: Each key area receives a distinct role, four spatial moves, three matching scenario cards, three project handles and explicit risks, avoiding interchangeable descriptions.

requirements.title_zh: 众智园AI自主创新加速区
report_sections: 重点区域详细设计
requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 上行 Ascent（众智园，约 192.1 ha）：清河界面开放实验室、K8 折返台地标、东侧标准与治理开放日动线、西侧小街区密路网。
requirements.evidence_summary_en: Ascent (Zhongzhiyuan, ~192.1 ha): an open-laboratory edge along Qinghe, the K8 REN Deck landmark, a governance open-day route to the east, and small blocks with dense streets to the west.

requirements.title_zh: 北京AI原点社区
report_sections: 重点区域详细设计
requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 原点 Origin（AI原点社区，约 104.3 ha）：K0 原点碑与原点缝合廊、西侧成果转化街、东侧人才公寓与社区服务、校区园区街区缝合。
requirements.evidence_summary_en: Origin (AI Origin Community, ~104.3 ha): the K0 marker and Origin stitching corridor, a translation street to the west, talent housing and services to the east, and campus-park-neighbourhood stitching.

requirements.title_zh: 大钟寺AI产业聚集区
report_sections: 重点区域详细设计
requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 回响 Echo（大钟寺，约 72.0 ha）：PS-X1 四象限地面步行连通、K1 回响钟亭声音地标、智能原生消费主界面、K2 数据要素会客厅。
requirements.evidence_summary_en: Echo (Dazhongsi, ~72.0 ha): the PS-X1 four-quadrant ground connection, the K1 Echo Bell landmark, an intelligence-native retail frontage and the K2 Data Commons Lounge.

requirements.title_zh: 一带总体概念与功能统筹方案设计
report_sections: 三层范围工作框架
蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 总体概念「京张折返带 The Switchback Belt」含主名称、英文名、口号「向人而智」、Logo 折返线方向、四色主色与自上而下贯通的命名系统（一带—一脊—三区—两翼—K0–K9），并有总体空间结构图。
requirements.evidence_summary_en: The overall concept The Switchback Belt provides a main name, English name, the claim 'Intelligence, turning toward people', a switchback logo direction, a four-colour palette and a naming system running from belt to spine to districts, wings and milestones, with an overall structure diagram.

requirements.title_zh: AI全栈自主创新体系与世界级AI创新生态设计
report_sections: 统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究
requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 六个全球案例（King's Cross / STATION F / 张江人工智能岛 / MaRS / one-north / Kendall Square）各给出可核验事实、空间机制与可迁移动作，形成 AI 创新生态图谱与要素编组机制。
requirements.evidence_summary_en: Six global cases each contribute a verifiable fact, a spatial mechanism and a transferable move, forming the ecosystem map and the element-marshalling mechanism.

requirements.title_zh: AI+场景赋能新范式与智能化AI活力城市设计
report_sections: AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 12 张 AI 场景卡（含 3 个产业测试验证场景）与 6 类用户画像，每张卡写明空间载体、数据来源与人工复核边界，并通过场景—空间—运营三重绑定进入实施清单。
requirements.evidence_summary_en: Twelve scenario cards (three of them industry test beds) and six personas, each card stating carrier, data source and human-review boundary, entering delivery only through a triple binding of space, operation and governance.

requirements.title_zh: AI公共空间、智能原生新业态与朝圣地标设计
report_sections: 蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划
requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 4 处 AI 朝圣地标（K0 原点碑与贡献荣誉墙、折返台与开源成果展示廊、回响钟亭、开发者散步道）与 10 处里程碑节点构成荣誉展示体系与公共空间组件库；东西缝合由 5 条廊道实现，南北贯通由 9.72 km 主脊实现。
requirements.evidence_summary_en: Four pilgrimage landmarks and ten milestone nodes form the honour-display system and public-space component library; east-west stitching uses five corridors and north-south continuity uses the 9.72 km spine.

requirements.title_zh: 百年京张文化、中关村文化与AI新文化融合叙事设计
report_sections: 蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
设计依据与资料清单
requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 三种文化被组织为一条可步行叙事：铁路文化是结构（命名与导视）、中关村文化是方法（成果转化街与发布厅）、AI 新文化是契约（映射规则、数据边界、可撤下的荣誉墙）。
requirements.evidence_summary_en: Three cultures form one walkable narrative: railway culture as structure, Zhongguancun culture as method and new AI culture as contract.

requirements.title_zh: 一带全球AI创新活动体系与长期运营设计
report_sections: 更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划
requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 5 项年度机制（通车日全球 AI 活动周、碑刻典礼、场景开放日、原点马拉松、城市共创开源征集）与“活动参与→场景申请→中试落位→空间政策对接→长期驻留”转化路径，全部标注为运营设想。
requirements.evidence_summary_en: Five annual mechanisms and a conversion path from participation to long-term residency, all explicitly marked as proposed operating concepts.
